title: Guardrail Testing for AI Shopping Assistants
summary: Adversarial testing of AI shopping assistants for unauthorised discounts, wrong prices, order-data leakage and unsafe product advice, with validated findings, fixes and a retest.

seo.title: AI Shopping Assistant Guardrail Testing | VipraTech
seo.description: Red-team testing for AI shopping assistants and WhatsApp bots: coupon abuse, price hallucination, order data leakage and prompt injection, with fixes.

problem.intro: Retailers are putting AI assistants on their sites, apps and WhatsApp channels to answer product questions, track orders and apply offers. An assistant that can look up orders or apply coupons can also be talked into doing the wrong thing, and a wrong price stated by your bot is a customer complaint in writing.

pain_points.title: Talked into discounts
pain_points.detail: Users try role-play and persistence to get coupons, price matches or free shipping the business never approved.

pain_points.title: Order tools that leak data
pain_points.detail: An order lookup tool without proper checks can reveal another customer's address or phone number.

pain_points.title: Hallucinated prices and policies
pain_points.detail: The assistant states a price, stock position or return policy that is not true, and screenshots spread.

pain_points.title: Injection through product content
pain_points.detail: Reviews, seller descriptions and Q&A that the assistant reads can carry instructions that change its behaviour.

solution.overview: We test your shopping assistant the way a determined customer, a fraudster or a competitor would. We map its knowledge sources, tools and permissions, then run automated adversarial suites and manual sessions in English, Hindi and Hinglish. Tests cover prompt injection, indirect injection through reviews and catalogue text, coupon and price manipulation, cross-customer data access through order tools, system prompt and margin disclosure, unsafe advice on supplements, cosmetics or baby products, and brand-damaging output. Every finding is reproduced by an engineer, rated and mapped to the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications. We retest after fixes and hand over a regression pack.
capabilities: Coupon, discount and price-manipulation tests against your actual offer rules
Cross-customer data access tests on order lookup, returns and address tools
Direct and indirect prompt injection, including payloads planted in reviews and product Q&A
Hallucination checks on prices, stock, delivery promises and return policy
Unsafe-advice and brand-safety tests for sensitive categories in English, Hindi and Hinglish
Validated findings mapped to OWASP LLM Top 10, with a regression pack for CI

workflow.title: Agree scope
workflow.detail: We agree the assistant, channels, test accounts, staging environment and what is off limits.

workflow.title: Map sources and tools
workflow.detail: Catalogue, policy and review sources, plus order, coupon and returns tools, are mapped with their permissions.

workflow.title: Run adversarial tests
workflow.detail: Automated suites and manual testers attack the assistant across every mapped risk and language.

workflow.title: Validate findings
workflow.detail: Engineers reproduce each candidate issue and drop anything they cannot confirm.

workflow.title: Report and fix
workflow.detail: You receive validated findings with evidence, severity and recommended fixes.

workflow.title: Retest and hand over
workflow.detail: Fixes are retested, and the test cases become a regression pack for future releases.

inputs: Access to the assistant in staging on web, app or WhatsApp
System prompts, tool definitions and model configuration
Offer, coupon and return policy rules
Test customer accounts with seeded orders
Sample catalogue, review and Q&A content
outputs: Validated findings with severity, transcripts and reproduction steps
Fix guidance for prompts, tools, retrieval and output filters
human_in_the_loop: Our engineers reproduce every automated finding before it reaches the report. Your product, legal and CX owners decide how each risk is treated, and tests run only against staging with test accounts.
integrations: Assistant platform or custom LLM application
Order, coupon and returns APIs in staging
guardrails: Tests use seeded test accounts, never real customer data
No coupons redeemed or orders placed in production
Testing only within agreed scope and time windows
Transcripts and findings stored encrypted with restricted access
compliance_notes: Wrong prices or policies stated by an assistant can raise issues under the Consumer Protection Act 2019 and E-Commerce Rules 2020; testing helps you find them before customers do.
Exposure of customer data through order tools is a personal data breach risk under the DPDP Act 2023.
For EU customers, the EU AI Act includes transparency obligations so that people know when they are interacting with an AI system.

pilot.scope: One assistant on one channel, such as website chat or a WhatsApp bot, in staging with its order and coupon tools.
deliverables: Rules of engagement and threat model
Validated findings report with fix guidance

what_we_measure.how: Test cases run per OWASP LLM category, tool and language.
Engineer-confirmed findings at each severity level.
Share of test conversations where the assistant stated a price, offer or policy that contradicts your rules.
Pass or fail status of each finding on retest.

faqs.q: We use a vendor's chatbot platform. Can you still test it?
faqs.a: Yes. We test the assistant as deployed for you, including your prompts, knowledge sources and connected tools. Issues in the platform itself are reported so you can raise them with the vendor.

faqs.q: Do you test in Hindi and Hinglish?
faqs.a: Yes. Guardrails that hold in English often fail in Hindi, Hinglish or transliterated text, so our attack library covers all three.

faqs.q: Will testing affect real customers or orders?
faqs.a: No. Tests run in staging with seeded accounts, and no coupons are redeemed or orders placed in production.
After any change to the model, prompts, tools or offer logic, and before major sale events. The regression pack lets your team run the core tests in CI between full reviews.
